data.name: Luminids
data.detailed_description:
Luminids is a cozy colony-building sandbox where you shape the land and guide a growing colony of little creatures with personalities and needs of their own. Your Luminids gather resources, build homes, and grow into a living settlement across forests, mountains, deserts, and frozen lands.

Plan from an isometric view, then step into first person to explore the world you’ve built together.

A Living World of Luminids

Luminids are small, expressive beings with their own needs, routines, and awareness. They gather resources, build structures, and respond to changes in their environment. Their behavior shifts based on conditions you create. Nurture the Luminids by providing space and safety as they grow.

Build from Above & Step Into Your World

Plan and build your community from above then switch instantly to first person to walk your settlements and meet your Luminids up close.

A Calm, Creative Experience

Luminids is designed to be calm and cozy, thoughtful and relaxing. The Luminids will not rush you forward - they invite experimentation, creativity, and quiet wonder.

Core Features

  • Build A Creature-Driven Civilization
    Luminids participate in building and shaping the world alongside you. The Luminids have a range of needs, awareness, personalities and expressions. They gather, build, rest, and adapt based on their environment.

  • Dual-Perspective Gameplay
    Build from an isometric builder view, then explore instantly in first person.

  • Living World Simulation
    Evolve & grow your environments, structures and world with the Luminids.

  • Progress Through Multiple Biomes
    From grasslands to deserts, each biome changes available resources, terrain, and how your settlement develops.

  • Online and Local Co-Op
    Build and explore together. Share a world guiding your settlements, and experiencing Luminids with your friends.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 630 / NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 360 (or equivalent with 2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
